Package com.nexuslink.core.metrics

Class MetricsCollector

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.core.metrics.MetricsCollector
public final class MetricsCollector extends Object
Thread-safe, in-memory collector of per-channel request metrics — throughput, error rate, and latency percentiles — for the monitoring dashboard. A "channel" is any label the caller groups by (a protocol, a connection name, a host). Lifetime totals (count/errors/bytes/min/max/mean) are exact; percentiles are computed over a bounded window of the most recent samples per channel.

percentile(long[], double) is a pure nearest-rank helper, unit-tested with known inputs; the collector itself is safe to call from many background threads.
